title: N.C.R.B., (M.H.A.) CRIME IN INDIA - 1994 9.6.2 The crime rate was very high in Pondicherry (1.6), Karnataka (1.0) and Maharashtra (0.5) in 1994. Incidence-wise, during this period, Karnataka (483) reported the highest number followed by Maharashtra (398), Andhra Pradesh (238), Tamil Nadu (232) and Uttar Pradesh (137). The above 5 States together contributed around 86 per cent of the total cases reported at All-India.
